6.140 rsPageBreakOnMatrixColumnGroup
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsPageBreakOnMatrixColumnGroup is a non-critical error that will occur if, for a Matrix, any Grouping
within the DynamicColumns element has the Grouping.PageBreakAtStart or Grouping.PageBreakAtEnd
element set to true.
